data.name: Riyajul
data.gender_notes: Riyajul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Riyajul is derived from the Sanskrit word rij, meaning 'delight, joy'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy. The name Riyajul carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Riyajul usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Riyajul is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the joy and happiness that comes from within and is a reminder to always find joy in life.
data.etymology: Riyajul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riyajul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
